text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, a fan letter arrives for Seeking
the
Pearl.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Haha, to think someone would take the
time to
write me a letter to express their
feelings. I must
wholly embrace their
heartfelt passion!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Excellent! Apparently, I've inspired them
to try
opening their own cafe!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Seeing you continuously taking on
challenges
made me want to try
accomplishing something of
my own,
Pearl!"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Things were pretty tough at first, but
business
has finally started to take off. It
would mean the
world to me if you
dropped by for a meal
sometime!" Why...
that sounds splendid!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Haha, you're right. I'm so happy.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Well then, let's go and pay their cafe a
visit!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I have arrived! Now where's that meal
you
mentioned?!

text_block_list.name: Cafe Owner
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what?! No way! P-Pearl... You
actually came?!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: What do you recommend?

text_block_list.name: Cafe Owner
text_block_list.text:
U-um, well, we grow all the fruits we use
in our
dishes, so I would suggest our
super-fruity cake!

text_block_list.name: Cafe Owner
text_block_list.text:
The toppings we use are freshly picked
each
morning from the garden out back!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Lovely! I'll have one of those, then!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... This is delicious! The fruits are
all so juicy!
This cake must be your best
seller!

text_block_list.name: Cafe Owner
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Well, some people do get hooked
after
trying it once, but I wouldn't go so
far as to say
it's particularly popular
among our guests.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Oh my... People are really missing out!
You should
try creating some buzz
around it by devising a fun
and flashy
way to serve it!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
For example, you could let customers
harvest
their own fruits to decorate their
cakes!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
You could call it the
"Pick-Your-Own-Fruit Cake"!

text_block_list.name: Cafe Owner
text_block_list.text:
Wow... That's a great idea! That would
definitely
get people talking about it! I'll
try that out!

text_block_list.name: Cafe Owner
text_block_list.text:
You're amazing, Pearl! You always have
such
unique ideas, and you're always
taking on
fascinating challenges! I look
up to you even
more now!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Haha, glad I could be of help. You know, I should be the one thanking you for supporting me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Several days later, Seeking the Pearl
receives
another fan letter from the
same cafe owner...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, what fantastic news! It seems the

Pick-Your-Own-Fruit Cake is a huge hit!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"I'm further exploring the potential of
homegrown
fruits by developing an
original beauty lotion."
Haha, sounds
like a great challenge to embark
on!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
But I can't let myself be beat! I'll achieve
even
more fabulous results so I can help
encourage
everyone around the world!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
From that day on, Seeking the Pearl
becomes
even more devoted to her
training.
